standard.summary: AdamW 路线的实现档位：auto（自动检测最优）、fused（CUDA fused 最快）、foreach（批处理，次快）、bnb（bitsandbytes 量化）。
standard.effect: fused ≈ 1.8ms/step；foreach ≈ 5ms/step；bnb ≈ 36ms/step（8bit 省显存但慢）。compiled_step = torch.compile 包装任意优化器 step。
standard.whenToUse: auto 在大多数情况下自动选择最优。显存极紧时用 bnb；追求极致速度时用 fused（需 CUDA）。
standard.avoidWhen: compiled_step 是实验性功能，首次编译慢且可能在某些优化器上失败（有自动回退）。

optionDescriptions.auto: 有啥用啥，自动挑 AdamW 实现。
optionDescriptions.foreach_adamw: foreach 批着更新，参数多时往往快一截。
optionDescriptions.torch_fused: CUDA fused，步更新更快，看驱动和版本。
optionDescriptions.bnb_8bit: 8bit 优化器状态，显存省一截。
optionDescriptions.compiled_step: 用 compile 包一层 step，实验向。

standard_en.summary: The implementation tier for the AdamW route: auto (detects the best automatically), fused (CUDA fused, the fastest), foreach (batched, second fastest), bnb (bitsandbytes quantised).
standard_en.effect: fused is roughly 1.8ms/step; foreach roughly 5ms/step; bnb roughly 36ms/step (8-bit saves VRAM but is slow). compiled_step wraps any optimizer's step in torch.compile.
standard_en.whenToUse: auto picks the best automatically in most cases. Use bnb when VRAM is extremely tight; use fused when you want maximum speed (it needs CUDA).
standard_en.avoidWhen: compiled_step is experimental: the first compile is slow and it may fail on some optimizers (there is an automatic fallback).

optionDescriptions.auto: Uses whatever is available, picking an AdamW implementation automatically.
optionDescriptions.torch_adamw: Pure PyTorch AdamW, the plainest of them.
optionDescriptions.foreach_adamw: Updates in foreach batches, often noticeably faster when there are many parameters.
optionDescriptions.torch_fused: CUDA fused: a faster step update, depending on your driver and version.
optionDescriptions.bnb_8bit: 8-bit optimizer state, saving a good chunk of VRAM.
optionDescriptions.compiled_step: Wraps the step in compile; experimental.
optionDescriptions.apex: Apex FusedAdam, which needs a separate install.
optionDescriptions.ao_8bit: torchao 8-bit, for large-parameter cases; it usually wants Triton.

advanced.principle: fused：将 AdamW 多个 kernel 合并为一次 CUDA launch，减少 kernel 发射开销；foreach：向量化遍历所有参数，比逐参数循环快约 3×；compiled_step：torch.compile 将整个 step 编译为 TorchScript/Triton kernel。
advanced.tradeoffs: fused 要求 CUDA 且不支持所有 tensor dtype；bnb 8bit 对 LoRA 小权重量化误差相对大，可能影响精细收敛。

advanced_en.principle: fused: merges several AdamW kernels into a single CUDA launch, reducing kernel launch overhead; foreach: vectorized iteration over all parameters, about 3x faster than a per-parameter loop; compiled_step: torch.compile compiles the whole step into TorchScript/Triton kernels.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: fused requires CUDA and does not support all tensor dtypes; bnb 8bit has relatively larger quantization error for small LoRA weights, which can affect fine-grained convergence.
